In today's video, I take you on a real-life tour of Jhang City, Pakistan, where I explore a local grocery mall and market to find out the actual prices of everyday items. Many people are curious about the cost of living in Pakistan and often ask whether groceries are expensive or affordable. In this vlog, I show you the real prices of daily essentials, including flour, rice, cooking oil, milk, snacks, beverages, biscuits, vegetables, fruits, personal care products, and many other household items.
